name: docs_search
description: Search nullplatform's public documentation (docs.nullplatform.com). Input: query (free text, English), limit (default 8). Returns pages with repo path, public URL, title, description and excerpt. Follow up with docs_page to read one.

name: docs_page
description: Read one documentation page by repo path (from docs_search), split into sections with anchors. Cite evidence as docs:<path>#<anchor>.
